name: Dane Hansen
current_role: CEO, White Castle Roofing (Lincoln, NE); co-founder of CompanyCam
profile: Dane Hansen, brother of CompanyCam CEO Luke Hansen, runs the family business White Castle Roofing, founded by their father Mike in the mid-1980s. CompanyCam, the contractor photo-documentation app (valued $2B in 2025), was born inside White Castle and he remains involved in product discussions.
interesting_fact: CompanyCam, which grew out of his family's roofing company, became Nebraska's first unicorn.
deep_cut_fact: Focused on processes and numbers, he built White Castle's cost calculator for estimating shingle and labour costs before becoming the roofing firm's CEO.
notes: Formal CompanyCam title/equity not confirmed. Has appeared on roofing podcasts about White Castle Roofing.

name: Dong Ming
current_role: Founder and CEO, Volant (沃兰特), Shanghai eVTOL maker
profile: Dong Ming (董明) is an aircraft engineer who worked on China's ARJ21 regional jet and on the C919 airliner from concept design. In 2021 he founded Volant in Shanghai to build passenger eVTOL aircraft; it has raised over RMB 5B across 13+ rounds and in May 2026 completed China's first piloted transition flight of its VE25-100 in Zigong, Sichuan.
interesting_fact: Volant's VE25-100 made China's first crewed eVTOL transition flight (May 2026), putting it among only three firms globally with that capability, per Chinese media.
deep_cut_fact: The name Volant comes from French, evoking a raptor in graceful flight; Dong has said eVTOL's potential impact is 'no less than the C919'.
notes: No verified public contact found; route via company. Chinese-language outreach advisable.

name: Kevin de Patoul
profile: Belgian business engineer and ex-Roland Berger management consultant who co-founded Keyrock in 2017 with Juan David Mendieta and Jeremy De Groodt. Keyrock is a digital-asset market maker and investment firm providing liquidity to 2,000+ markets; it hit a $1.1B valuation in a Series C led by SC Ventures with Ripple in March 2026.
interesting_fact: Keyrock's valuation quadrupled to ~$1.1B in its 2026 Series C, making it a Belgian crypto unicorn.
deep_cut_fact: His interest in crypto began while he was a management consultant at Roland Berger, where he came to believe digital assets could make the global financial system more efficient.
notes: Frequent conference speaker (Consensus, Paris Fintech Forum) and op-ed author on Blockworks/CoinDesk; receptive to media.

name: Yang keying
profile: Listed as a founder of Tastien (Chinese burger chain, ~$1B). Reports say Tastien was founded in 2012 by Wei Youchun and two other post-80s partners, but no source found naming Yang Keying, so the role could not be confirmed.
interesting_fact: Tastien began as a pizza brand in 2012 and pivoted to 'Chinese burgers', growing to 12,000+ stores.
notes: Possibly one of Wei Youchun's two unnamed co-founding partners; unverified.
